g.text: status: Registered | Cancelled; attendance: Unmarked | Attended | Absent
One participant entry per volunteer. Cancellation retains it; rejoining reuses it.
registeredCount = number of Registered entries; availablePlaces = capacity - registeredCount
Campaign.favorites[] = Volunteer User IDs; Campaign.certificates[] = granted Volunteer IDs
Certificate eligibility: Completed campaign + Registered participant + Attended
Organization and Campaign locations: country BH, governorate, area, address, latitude, longitude
Coordinates are optional pairs: omit both to preserve; send both null to clear.
Dates are UTC in MongoDB; input/display uses Asia/Bahrain (UTC+03:00).
